'''Chapter 162''' is titled "Adventure in the Kingdom of Sand".

==Cover Page==
[[Jango's Dance Paradise]], Vol. 28: "Two Dancing Heroes, Baby".

[[Jango]] and [[Fullbody]] strike a victory pose over the vanquished [[Tulip Pirates]], a huge crowd of civilians cheering them on.

==Short Summary==
On their way to [[Yuba]], the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] encounter the difficulties of living in a desert with the heat and the thirst as well as its strange inhabitants: the stealing [[Animal Species/Arabasta Saga#Warusagi Birds|warusagi birds]], the giant lizards and a [[Matsuge|pervert camel]] who allows only women to ride on him. After all these adventures, the Straw Hats finally reach their destination.

==Long Summary==
After walking all day in the desert under the sun, the Straw Hats are exhausted, Luffy then drinks some water which upsets Usopp, and the two get into an argument. Finally the Straw Hats take a break, only to have their stuff stolen by thieving birds, Luffy then goes off to chase the birds but encounters a giant lizard. Fortunately it is no match for the straw hats and they kill it, and eat it, they also find a camel whom they name Matsuge. Luffy then starts to hallucinate and after a while falls asleep, forcing the crew to carry him until he wake up, and by night they have reached Yuba, unfortunately Vivi finds something wrong with the town.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*The Straw Hats rescue [[Matsuge|a camel]] that assists them in crossing the desert.
*The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] reach Yuba.
